the molecular basis of epigenetic variation and inheritance, and its influence on phenotype.
the epigenetic control of gene expression, and in particular the mechanisms underlying the inheritance of epigenetic states.
the epigenetic regulation of the murine agouti gene, and in particular the role of DNA methylation.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Avy allele is a complex epigenetic modifier of agouti expression, and the phenotypic variation between individuals reflects the incomplete epigenetic state in the somatic and germline cells of the Avy allele.

the Avy allele is an interesting model for epigenetic inheritance and phenotypic variability, but that its epigenetic state is more complex than has previously been thought.
the Avy allele is not a simple model of epigenetic inheritance.
